description: Run a GA4 aggregated report over the property's event data for the requested dimensions and metrics.

property_id.description: The GA4 property id to report on.

dimensions.description: Optional list of dimensions (each an object with a 'name', or a plain string). Valid names: date, country, pagePath, deviceCategory.

metrics.description: Optional list of metrics (each an object with a 'name', or a plain string). Valid names: sessions, activeUsers, screenPageViews, eventCount.

date_ranges.description: Optional list of date range objects (startDate, endDate, name); echoed back in report metadata.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the report with dimensionHeaders, metricHeaders, rows, rowCount and kind.

description: Run a GA4 realtime aggregated report over the property's realtime data.

property_id.description: The GA4 property id to report on.

dimensions.description: Optional list of realtime dimensions (each an object with a 'name', or a plain string). Valid names: country, deviceCategory, unifiedScreenName.

metrics.description: Optional list of realtime metrics (each an object with a 'name', or a plain string). Valid names: activeUsers, eventCount.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the realtime report with dimensionHeaders, metricHeaders, rows, rowCount and kind.

description: Run multiple aggregated reports for a property in a single batch request.

property_id.description: The GA4 property id to report on.

requests.description: Optional list of report request objects, each with dimensions, metrics and dateRanges.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has kind and a 'reports' list of aggregated report objects.

description: Get the dimension and metric metadata available for a property.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has the metadata name plus dimensions and metrics descriptors.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the property object.
